name: HOLIDAY INN EXPRESS HOTEL AND SUITES

violations.description: Temperature measuring devices. — --Temperature measuring device was not provided. Thermometer was not available in the homestyle refrigerator in the kitchen. Thermometers should be available for monitoring temperatures.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Cover for portable fan on the microwave was found dirty. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Ceiling and vents throughout the kitchen were found dirty. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. Scrambled eggs were found at 48F and 2% milk was found at 46F in the commercial refrigerator. Potentially hazardous foods should be maintained at 41F or below. **These items were discarded.

General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Food employee was observed putting on gloves without washing her hands first. Hands should be washed before putting on gloves.

General employee practices. — --Food employee observed drinking/using open beverage container outside of designated area. Food employee was observed drinking beverage in the kitchen. Beverages should not be consumed in food prep areas.

Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. Test strips were not available for checking the sanitizing concentration of the sanitizer in the 3 compartment sink and other sanitizers. Test strips should be available to assure proper strength is used for sanitizing equipment.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
